AHCINT 1.3.0.0-usos1 - MODIFIED version of AHCINT 1.3.0.0 (ages2001,
https://github.com/ages2001/AHCINT, tag v1.3.0.0 = commit 7be9c9b8), changed
by the USOS project on 2026-09-30. Not an upstream release. Licence: GPL-3.0,
as the original (../1.3.0.0/LICENSE).

Changes (patches/0001-usos1-flush-cache.patch; every spot in src/ is marked
"MODIFIED (USOS 1.3.0.0-usos1)"):

- SYNCHRONIZE CACHE (10)/(16), SRB_FUNCTION_FLUSH and SRB_FUNCTION_SHUTDOWN
  send FLUSH CACHE (E7h), or FLUSH CACHE EXT (EAh) on LBA48 drives, to the
  drive (AhciFlushPort). 1.3.0.0 completed them as success without telling
  the drive, so the drive's write cache was never forced out. A drive that
  aborts the command (no flush support) counts as flushed.
- WRITE (10)/(16) with FUA (byte 1 bit 3) is followed by a FLUSH CACHE.
- MODE SENSE returns the caching page (08h) with WCE taken from IDENTIFY
  word 85 bit 5, so the class driver sees the write cache and issues
  SYNCHRONIZE CACHE; the mode buffer grows from 64 to 96 bytes.

Nothing else changed. Built with WDK 7.1 (build.cmd, x86 WXP target, the
sources file's WS03 version); every import (12: ntoskrnl, scsiport) resolves
on the Windows 2000 SP4 kernel and scsiport.
